title: Guaranteed Low-Rank Tensor Recovery from Modewise Measurements via Normalized Block-Weighted Riemannian Gradient Descent
abstract: arXiv:2609.24679v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We consider the recovery of low-multilinear-rank tensors from linear measurements and propose an adaptive block-weighted modewise Riemannian gradient descent method. The method combines memory-efficient modewise measurements with a normalized adaptive weighting strategy for the core and factor components of the Riemannian gradient. The weighting improves convergence without increasing the multilinear-rank bound of the search direction or the size of the reduced core used for retraction. Under the tensor restricted isometry property and a suitable initialization, we establish local linear convergence and derive sampling guarantees for sub-Gaussian and subsampled orthogonal with random sign (SORS) measurements. translated_abstract: 我们研究从线性测量中恢复低多线性秩张量的问题，并提出了一种自适应分块加权的模态黎曼梯度下降方法。该方法将内存高效的模态测量与针对黎曼梯度中核心张量和因子分量的归一化自适应加权策略相结合。这种加权方式在不增加搜索方向的多线性秩界、也不增加用于回缩操作的约简核心大小的前提下改善了收敛性。在张量受限等距性质和适当初始化的条件下，我们建立了局部线性收敛性，并推导了针对次高斯测量和带随机符号的子采样正交测量（SORS）的采样保证。在合成低Tucker秩张量上的数值实验表明，所提出的方法在保持可靠恢复性能的同时减少了迭代次数和计算时间，尤其是在接近恢复阈值时以及对于……
tldr: 该论文提出了一种归一化分块加权的模态黎曼梯度下降方法，在不增加搜索方向秩界的前提下加速低多线性秩张量的恢复，并在张量受限等距性质下证明了局部线性收敛性，给出了次高斯和SORS测量的采样保证。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a normalized block-weighted modewise Riemannian gradient descent method that improves convergence for low-multilinear-rank tensor recovery without increasing the rank bound of the search direction, and establishes local linear convergence with sampling guarantees for sub-Gaussian and SORS measurements under the tensor restricted isometry property.
